We're planning to raise $10,000 to bring clean drinking water to a village in the Tigray region of Ethiopia.  We're partnering with [http://water.org Water Partners International].  Please poke around [http://water.org on their website] for more information.

View these two files for details about the Tigray region and what a water source can mean for people living there.

* [http://solseed.org/Image:Ethiopia_Text_and_Pictures.jpg Ethiopia verbal description and photos]
